user_saw: The completed Feishu reply card repeated its final paragraph when both streaming previews and completed-block streaming were enabled.
summary: The fix matches completed blocks against the cumulative preview in order and appends only blocks the preview has yet to cover.
reasoning: The oldest available dispatcher already accepted both streams and appended completed blocks unless the block exactly matched the last update, so a tail already present in a longer preview could be appended again. The October refactor preserved that append behavior, and the later tool-call fix changed snapshot handling while retaining the same block path. The available path history stopped at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify when the defect first became reachable or whether the combined mode had previously handled it correctly.
